description: Packages that parse, dereference, validate or diff OpenAPI documents, which no server package may depend on (contract-changes: Contract diffs run only where the specs already are; design.md, Design rules: Contract changes; design.md, Technical decisions: T12). The server packages are the apps the image runs, apps/server and apps/web, and every workspace package they depend on. Tiehall generates its own document with zod-openapi and serves it to the API reference page, which renders it in the browser; neither reads a provider's spec, so neither is listed. Add new parsers and diff tools here; tools/repo-checks/src/check-spec-reading.ts enforces the list in CI.

scopes.@pb33f: pb33f's OpenAPI tools, openapi-changes among them

packages.express-openapi-validator: a validator that reads an OpenAPI document
packages.openapi-backend: a framework that reads an OpenAPI document
packages.openapi-request-validator: a validator that reads an OpenAPI document
packages.swagger-client: a client that resolves OpenAPI documents
